faqs.question: I got 3000 rank in TS EAMCET. Can I get a seat for CSE branch at UCEOU?
faqs.answer: University College of Engineering, Osmania University TS EAMCET round 1 cutoff is 3021 for the General Home State category students. Based on the TS EAMCET Round 1 cutoff 2024, a rank of 3000 under the General Home State quota is sufficient to get a seat in BTech in CSE programme at UCEOU. However, the cutoff for admission to the B.Tech programs at UCEOU through TS EAMCET varies every year and depends on various factors such as the number of applicants, the difficulty level of the exam, the availability of seats, and the category of the candidate. So, it is always better to visit the official website of the institute or the TS EAMCET counselling website for the latest cutoff ranks.

admission_process.title: UCEOU Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: University College of Engineering, Hyderabad admissionsareentrance-based. Commonly known asUCEOU, the college gives BE, ME, and MCA courses in affiliation withOsmania University. Admission to programmes is done based on the performance of students in the entrance test, then a centralised counselling. The admission and application are mainly held online. Interested students can read the article to learn about the courses, eligibility, and admission process for the college.

UCEOU course admissionis subject to a an acceptable score in the national/state-level entrance exam along with the fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria set by the institute. Students can pursue full-time and part-time programmes in the stream of Engineering and Technology given through the twelve departments of the institute. Working professionals can also pursue the Bachelor of Engineering (BE) course via lateral admissions. Columns below areUCEOU coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Class 12 with a minimum aggregate of 45% withPhysics, Chemistry andMathematicsas compulsory subjects

University College of Engineering, Hyderabad feelies betweenINR 30,000andINR 4.8 lakh. The total tuition fee includes several components, some of which are one-time payable. Additionally, students also need to pay a special fee that varies according to the programme chosen. Applicants must pay the admission fee at the time of reporting to secure their spot at the college. Find course-wiseUCEOU feesin the table below:
Note: This data is from official sources and can change.

University College of Engineering, Osmania University offers a limited number of seats for its courses. Students need to participate in exam-specific counselling for seat allotment. The college offers an additional seat intake of 15% for foreign students and 10% for BE lateral entry. At the time of reporting at the allotted institute, selected students must pay the admission fees and carry the original documents. Interested students can check out the following table to know about theUCEOU seat intakefor the offered programmes:
Note: This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

To apply for a course at the University College of Engineering, Osmania University, students who meet the specific eligibility criteria can submit their application online on the official website. The admission procedure includes several steps, such as application, selection, and counselling, then an admission confirmation. T
UCEOU Application Process 2025

For UG and PG courses at UCEOU, students should look into the official website of the college and click on the "Apply now" button. Fill the application form with all the imp. information and pay the application fee. In the final step, upload scanned copies of the required documents.
Entrance Exam and Shortlisting
University College of Engineering, Hyderabad accepts scores of many national-level entrance exams, likewise, GATE, TS PGECET, and EAMCET for undergraduate courses like BTech and other PG programmes.
Release of Cut off or Merit List

A selection list is released indicating the names of the selected or shortlisted students. It is published on the university's official website. The merit list students can participate in the next round of admission.
Counselling

For the UG and PG courses, seat allotment is done via ounselling. Shortlisted students have to participate in counselling for the national level exams, and the counselling schedule is published on the official website.
Fee Payment & Admission Confirmation
Once students complete the above steps, they can finalise the seat by paying the fee amount.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for MCA at UCEOU?
faqs.answer: The overall fee for MCA at UCEOU is INR 30,000.The fee information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Candidates might have to pay other fee components at the time of admission. UCEOU offers full-time MCA at PG level for two years. Admission to all the MCA is subject to a valid score in the TSICET entrance exam along with the fulfillment of the minimum eligibility criteria set by the college.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for MCA at UCEOU?
faqs.answer: Candidates who has a Bachelor degree with minimum 50% aggregate (45% for SC/ST) in any discipline with Maths as a compulsory subject and has a valid score in the Telangana State Integrated Common Entrance Test (TSICET) are eligible for the MCA at UCEOU. Therefore, candidates must also check for TSICET exams eligibility criteria and apply for the exam via TSCIET official website.

faqs.question: Can I join University College of Engineering, Osmania University without GATE?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can also join Osmania University without GATE because there are many more exams from which we can join Osmania University like TSICET, CMAT, APECET, TS EAMCET etc. These are the national-level exams held in India through which we can join Osmania University by getting certain ranks which differs for different exams. GATE is one of the exams through which we can get a seat in this college.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in University College of Engineering, Osmania University?
faqs.answer: No, University College of Engineering, Osmania University does not accept direct admissions for its full-time programmes. Admissions are strictlyentrance-based. Students must appear and clear the accepted entrance exams as per the offered course to get into the college. Scores obtained by the applicants in exams, such as TS ICET, TS PGCET, and TS EAMCET are considered while shortlisting candidates. Additionally, students must also clear the eligibility criteria of the desired programme before applying for it. However, lateral admissions to the Bachelor of Engineering (BE) course are accepted for working professionals. Students can visit the official website of the college to know further.

faqs.question: How do I get admission to various courses at University College of Engineering, Osmania University?
faqs.answer: To join any of the programmes offered at University College of Engineering, Osmania University, students must meet the admission criteria of the programme as specified by the institute. Furthermore, since admissions are entrance-based, it is mandatory for candidates to appear and clear the accepted exams. Once the results are out, students need to participate in the counselling process conducted by the concerning body to get into UCE Hyderabad. reviews.review_heading: Prestigious Institute in Hyderabad.

reviews.review_heading: Prefer college for studies, not for fests.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good with good rooms and a balcony. The rooms are 3 sharing with a good balcony. A big open balcony is on the 2nd floor of the hostel where students enjoy the weather. Veg food is available at the mess. Many food varieties are cooked for both breakfast and lunch.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, and the faculty members are really good, the best for education.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is super cool. Classrooms are also very good. The library is seriously good. We have Wi-Fi everywhere in the university. In the hostel, the food is good. Medical facilities are good. Sports are super cool. We do have tournaments, and we get grade points if we win.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good, your campus life will be somewhat average, and the rest will be good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, has the speed, and in classrooms, social media is blocked. Classrooms have digital boards, and even in the library, you have a separate place for doing technical work and a separate place for studying from books. The mess food is good, but no non-vegetarian food is provided, only boiled eggs are provided. Sports and games are played on the ground at any time till night, and even the medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I think this is the best college for placements in private universities.
reviews.review_text: Good, as it is a new building, and still more construction should be done. AIML (AI) is the best course in our campus.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty was average, students should learn on their own, infrastructure was good, campus was neat.
reviews.review_text: Until the construction, everything was so good, but the campus is under construction. The food was not so good, as it was not spicy. The canteen was so minimal that there were no available items, only a few items were available. You can order the things you want from outside food, Amazon, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review about Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Amravati CSE.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi available is good; there were required labs and classrooms with a library. The college is under construction and has facilities but not many luxurious facilities. The hostel is the best; the food is of better quality; there is good Wi-Fi; there are enough rooms with personal washrooms; medical support is present; the canteen is good but not with all kinds of food items; there are also indoor games available. There are sufficient labs also.

reviews.review_heading: Something about Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Amravati.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite neat, good, and well constructed, and it is also quite formal. We have many indoor and outdoor games. Competitions are held among other colleges and campuses.

The highest and average packages offered during IIIT Surat placements 2024 were INR 64 LPA and INR 13,68 LPA, respectively. The BTech placement rate recorded for CSE and ECE branches were 63% and 68.57%, respectively.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the faculty, except for two or three. Placement was good in 2021-22.
reviews.review_text: There's no dedicated hostel, all accommodations are private. Wi-Fi is very slow, and classrooms don't have air conditioning, though the library is good enough. Labs are getting worse day by day, and the hostel provides poor facilities. There's no proper schedule, which is essential.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for those who didn't have any other good colleges like IITs and NITs.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good and decent but students should travel by bus to go to the hostel, it is almost like 7-8 KM away from campus. On-campus hostel is still being constructed. Wi-Fi is also there in hostels, and they are working decently. Games are also good, you can play.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the fee and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Own hostel construction is underway, and will be ready around 2026. Until then remote hostel facility is available. New director is very good and construction rate is very fast as of now. Many new things are being added to the college like sporting facilities, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It's worth looking at one time.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities aren't good. The college has arrangements with private hostels where first and second-year students currently reside. A paid bus commute, with fees payable to the college, is available. For internet access, students must rely on their phone's network and hotspot for laptop use. Currently, third-year students live in PGs and rented flats.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive community here at IIIT Surat.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus is a sort of temporary type with Wi-Fi campus, labs for CSE, ECE, and physics library. Our college doesn't have it's campus so we are staying at a hostel running by private authorities and college provides shuttle service. Sports facilities available are volleyball court, kabaddi mat, carrom board, TT table, and chess.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Surat - Indian Institute of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: We do not have hostels at our college. Other things are satisfactory. Wi-Fi is satisfactory in hostels and in the college as well. Classrooms are not expected but it is functional. The canteen has been improved from the previous year. Sports and games are being encouraged now after performing so well in inter-IIIT events and successfully winning trophies.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Surat by one of the students.
reviews.review_text: The worst infrastructure any college in the world would have. We have 3 labs for computer science, 2 for electronics, and 1 for physics. Toilets are bigger than the library. The library of IIT Bombay is bigger than our college. The lowest Wi-Fi we have to use our mobile data and our college is built in the middle of the farm therefore even the mobile network is not working properly. There is no sports ground. The worst canteen food is provided. Our college does not even have a hostel.

reviews.review_heading: College with average placements.
reviews.review_text: It is currently running on a temporary campus in Kamrej. Construction has not started. It is small but has basic facilities. It has 6 labs. They are well-equipped with smart gadgets which are new. All have good and new computers with Ryzen processors.

reviews.review_heading: College is good with good placements, average campus life, and encouraging faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Since college is operating in its temporary campus built in Kamrej in Pasodara Gam, there is no proper building. It is of tin shed but properly managed and is average. There is no campus life, and there is no sports facility other than a table tennis table in campus. Hostel is third party, so you cannot expect much. It is average, and mess food is average.

reviews.review_heading: This review has major information related to IIIT Surat college.
reviews.review_text: There is no own hostel for our college, Indian Institute of Information Technology Surat, so they provided hostels in two different schools, and one is Matrix Global Hostel, which is the worst due to lack of playgrounds and proper food in the mess. They have provided a small cupboard with only 2 racks, which can barely fit our accessories.

reviews.review_heading: Great in Academics, but working as a dream campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is not yet fully built but is under construction. Wi-Fi, library, and required labs are available, including classrooms. Talking about hostels, currently, the hostels are not yet built, so for the time being, we are in third-party hostel facilities. Food and bathroom/washroom facilities are okay. If any problem arises, after some complaints, they are cleared out. Talking about medical facilities, they are kinds of available, but not in the hostel, but rather nea...

reviews.review_heading: Good for placement but bad for hostel/campus life.
reviews.review_text: There are 2 hostels: one is Matrix, and the other is SUV. People prefer SUVs over Matrix because they have personal washrooms along with a playing ground and optical fiber Wi-Fi. Currently, we reside on a temporary campus, and AC is only present in CSE labs; other classes don't have AC. But the facilities for studying the subjects are all present. The campus is very small, and there is not much room to do anything. The canteen food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements but disappointing campus life.
reviews.review_text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Surat has no permanent hostel. College management are saying that they will provide it by next year. The hostel provided by the college is a private hostel, which is 10 km far from campus, which is in rural Surat. There are no good sports facilities in our college; we often outsource them.

reviews.review_heading: B.Tech in computer science from the IIIT Surat, which offers good placements and the best faculty.
reviews.review_text: IIIT Surat has really good infrastructure for the CSE course. Students were provided with all the necessary facilities at this college. facilities: Medical Centre: The medical facility is available 24x7 including ambulances, doctors, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with good placements and improving infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent and improving gradually. Classrooms are well maintained with projectors, and laboratories are adequate equipped for practical learning. Wi-Fi connectivity is available across the campus, though speed can vary at times. The library has sufficient academic resources and study space. Hostel facilities are manageable, with average room quality and basic amenities provided. Mess food quality is acceptable but repetitive. Sports facilities and medical support are available...

reviews.review_heading: My college is my success.
reviews.review_text: The college's infrastructure is excellent, and the hostel infrastructure is perfect. In my hostel, each floor has a total of 24 rooms, with each room shared by 3 members. The facilities available in the hostel include 3 cots, 3 cupboards, charging ports, and a cot-drying stand. The quality of food in my hostel is not very high, but the canteen is okay.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Sri City - Indian Institute of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college was not that good and it's so average compared to other cities IITs. We could expect a better hostel infrastructure for the amount of fee they were charging but the infrastructure of the classrooms was good. There were ACs in every room.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good, but the only thing that should be improved is the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are not so good for a student’s engineering life, but according to the course, they are very good. The hostel provides high-quality food and good facilities. The medical facilities are awesome. For sports and games, there are very good places to play.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the faculty and administration. The placements in 2023 were too good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is too good. The labs are equipped with modern equipment. The classrooms have centralized AC. There is a library. For the 1st year in the hostel, there are three members in a room. Each is provided with a bed, an almirah, a desk, and charging points. The mess food is manageable. They serve chicken twice a week.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive review of IIIT Sri City: College life, hostel, placements, and about faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Academic block boasts a well-designed and modern campus and provides an excellent environment for learning, and research, but in cultural activities, not much is expected. There are limited cultural activities. There is a drawback for those looking to engage in a wider array of music and acting. Sports are not much encouraged only one cricket ground for all 4-year students. There is only one football and volleyball ground, and there is no sports complex. Hostel is quite good but the problem is W...

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Sri City by Dileep.
reviews.review_text: The campus academic block structure is so good and decent. Classrooms are decent with centralized AC. Each room is capable of holding up to 120 students. There is one cafeteria in the academic block. There is super market nearby. Hostels are too good and daily cleaning will be done.

reviews.review_heading: My college is the one which is being developed.
reviews.review_text: The hostels here are small but have good space. The Wi-Fi is too good and it works very well. The beds are good and the fans work properly. We have well-maintained rooms. The labs are done properly and organised manner. Library is small but always full classrooms are too good like IIT Bombay style. There are many fun sports.

reviews.review_heading: It is really a good college: IIIT Sri City review.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel infrastructure is too good. It was nice to stay here. Our hostel campus consists of 60 rooms. Wi-Fi is good. I will give it a 5-star rating. Classrooms are nice and have central ACs. There is a library on our campus.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in IIIT Sri City.
reviews.review_text: We have 24-hour Wi-Fi facility in our college. College has AC facility also. Every student has a separate cupboard and fan. Many technical clubs, CP lab, and ECE lab are there. We have good classroom infrastructure with AC, and also the library contains a lot of books technical and general. Hostel has Wi-Fi facility with clean bed and cupboard. We have two types food facilities, North and South. There is a PT sir who helps us to play games and takes us to many inter-IIIT tournaments. We also hav...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied by choosing this college.
reviews.review_text: Our labs are very hygienic, and every lab contains AC. Every classroom contains AC, mike, and charging point. Our library contains so many books and newspapers. We can take the books or newspapers which are in the library for 1 month by giving our roll number in the library.

reviews.review_heading: I am very lucky to get this college .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is awesome. We have a library and a gym in an academic building. Both the gym and library are open until midnight. The hostel has good facilities. There are 24/7 drinking water service and a canteen for snacks. They also provide speed and uninterrupted Wi-Fi. There is a cricket ground, football ground and basketball court.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Sri City in the view of a fresher.
reviews.review_text: The college and the hostel both have good Wi-Fi facilities. All the classrooms have air-conditioners and fans. The mess food is not too good and it is average only. All the sports are encouraged. If students have absolutely no expectations from the hostel life then they can join it. However, the hostel is compulsory for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities should be improved in the college.
reviews.review_text: Actually, it is a new campus and not fully built. There are enough classrooms and hostels. Girls hostel is outside the campus nearly 1.5 kilometers away. The bus facility is provided. Wi-Fi, labs, and libraries are well-equipped. The food available in the mess is above average.

reviews.review_heading: The college of Indian Institute of Information Technology Sri City is very incredible.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at our college is pretty peaceful. The atmosphere is very good. We have 4 buildings for all UG courses. There is 24/7 Wi-Fi in hostels. Labs and classrooms have very good infrastructure. The food available in the hostel is quite not bad. It is a bit good in the canteen. We have medical facilities.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Lucknow Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Yes, in some circumstances the Lucknow Institute of Technology (LIT) will offer direct admission. If we are talking about B.Tech. courses, high school graduates with the compulsory subjects may use management quota seats, whereupon direct admission will be the case, with no need for the entrance exam to take place. Winning entrance exam admissions through relatives remains the main criterion but other ways include the meeting of the minimum pass mark of an examination. As for Master's programs (such as M.Tech and MBA), direct admissions are also considered on the basis of merit or management quota. LIT official website and the admissions office are to be contacted for detailed information and the processes involved.

reviews.review_heading: If you take admission, you will definitely find it worth it.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent infrastructure for both academics and hostel life. Classrooms are spacious. It includes smart boards and Wi-Fi. The library offers a wide range of books and e-resources. The hostel has clean rooms, 24/7 water and electricity supply. Along with common study areas, hygienic mess facilities, and proper security. It ensures a comfortable and safe environment for students.

reviews.review_heading: NIMS University, Jaipur 2013 honest review on infrastructure and academics.
reviews.review_text: The course has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a good library with books and digital resources. Hostels are clean and secure with shared rooms. The mess provides tasty food with good variety. The canteen offers snacks and refreshments. Medical facilities are available on campus with 24x7 emergency support. For sports, there are grounds and courts for cricket, football, badminton, and a gym for fitness.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely amazing experience.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided in my university are outstanding. The infrastructure is so cool and amazing that everyone likes it. There is 24/7 Wi-Fi available in the hostel, and all facilities are good. The food is also good, and all facilities are excellent. The management is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: A satisfying view for the college.
reviews.review_text: They have good infrastructure. They provide us with Wi-Fi in the whole campus, 24*7 libraries, and classrooms with digital boards and projectors. In the hostel, they provide satisfying facilities like Wi-Fi, 24-hour light, and water supply, all were provided with full facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for engerning.
reviews.review_text: It provides very good facilities. Wi-Fi is good. Labs, classrooms, and the library are very good. Rooms are very clean. Hostels are good. The furnishing is good. The food quality is good. There is a huge ground to play cricket and football.

reviews.review_heading: Overall as far as I have seen everything is up to the mark. The only problem is of fine system.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good, more then I expected. There are many buildings many departments for each and every course enough room is available for each departments. Hostel aslo provides big rooms with 3 students per room. All type of facilities are available for hostel students like restaurant, gym etc. Overall Infrastructure is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good facilities for sports.
reviews.review_text: Hostels and mess food are average but rooms are clean. Classrooms are quite good with air-conditioners. Labs are well. Library is big and good. College is well constructed with an elevator. There are air-conditioners and non-air-conditioners with single, double, and triple beds in the hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and teaching facilities but I doubt the placement.
reviews.review_text:
The college infrastructure is quite good whereas the hostel facilities are not up to the mark and they're quite old. The classrooms are fine with Air conditioners and Wi-Fi facilities with lab rooms being well-equipped as well
The hostel is quite old having common bathrooms and Wi-Fi is not provided either, whereas the food is quite good on a hostel level.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college, I recommend you to take admission here.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are very good, it’s Wi-Fi enabled. There are three seater and two seater rooms available depending upon your requirements. A gym is also there and everything else is good in the hostel. The infrastructure is good and so is the hostel life. I have been living in the hostel for years now.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because of the faculty memers.
reviews.review_text: They are just concerned with the infrastructure and they keep the university up to date for people coming to take a tour of the respective college. The labs are not updated, and we rarely get new lab equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Our college's building is highly modernised and has well-furnished classrooms and equipped labs.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi, and every building is modernised and well-equipped. The hostel is well-furnished, and good food is served in the mess. There is a huge cricket ground, a football field, basketball court, tennis and badminton court. There is also a well-equipped gym and swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIMS Institute of Engineering & Technology, NIMS University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The library is one of the important facilities frequently used by students and faculty to support the learning-teaching needs. Facilities like buildings, equipment, services, etc., are good. Hotels may charge extra for using swimming pool, gym etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college has decent placements and great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good with a proper hostel, mess and faculty members. The college is well-connected to the city. For academic, labs and classrooms are of good standards. Food quality in the mess is decent, but it can be improved to great. Hostel and classrooms are Wi-Fi enabled. The Library is quite resourceful.  Sports and medical facilities are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: I love my college because of the competitive atmosphere and cooperative staff members.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is spread over 11 hectares of land, which is big regarding occupied space. We have a canteen, central library, 24/7 health club, cafeteria, separate hostels for boys and girls, two hostels for staff and they are well maintained. Food is okay in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: A place to be (NIMS University) for the overall development of a student.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good in the university. In every college, they have their auditoriums of 500 sittings. The university is developing day to day construction work for specific swimming pool and gym is under construction. The quality of labs are good, and all the important machines and equipment is available with ease.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by Assam University?
faqs.answer: Assam University offers over 86 UG, PG, diploma, doctoral, and certificate programmes in various fields, such as Engineering, Arts, Science, and Commerce, and for admission in many of the courses and specialisation there are specific entrance exams such as CUET-UG for admission in UG courses, CUET-PG for admission in PG course, JEE-Main for admission in BTech course.Students need to prepare well for the aforesaid entrance examinations because having a good rank will ensure that the candidate becomes eligible for further counselling, followed by document verification and fee payment.

faqs.question: Does Assam University accept admission through CUET-UG?
faqs.answer: Assam University accepts admission through various national-level, state-level & university-level entrance exams. CUET-UG is also one of those entrance exams that Assam University enrol candidates.Students need to prepare well for the CUET-UG exam because only those candidates can register further for the admission process whose rank or scorecard will be within the range specified by the university, i.e. merit list, which will be released on Assam University's official website.Apart from CUET-UG, there are several other gateway exams for admission to Assam University, such as JEE-Main, CAT, WSAT, CUCET, etc.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in MCom at Assam University?
faqs.answer: Assam University accepts admission in MCom through CUET-PG, for which the candidate should have passed BCom with a minimum of 50% aggregate. Therefore, candidates willing to take admission in MCom at Assam University must take the CUET-PG exam and must prepare well to achieve a good rank because only those applicants whose rank is above the closing rank specified in the merit list released by Assam University will be considered for the counselling round followed by the document verification and fees payment.Also, 50% of the MCom course seats are reserved for Assam University internal students, i.e., those who have passed the qualifying examination from Assam University affiliated college.

faqs.question: What can students do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

paragraphs: MSIT admission 2025is open. The institute offers eight UG & PG programmes under multiple specialisations. MSIT admissions are offered based on scores of national or state-level entrance exams likeMAT/ CAT/ JEMAT, WBJEE/ JEE Main, WBJEE JECA, and GATE/ WBUT PGET scores for various courses.The mode of application for all the courses at MSIT is online/offline. MSIT admission 2025 is both merit and entrance-based. Candidates must meet the basic eligibility requirements of the programme they are applying for. Check below the eligibility and selection criteria related to MSIT course admissions:
Know more aboutMSIT Courses

Meghnad Saha Institute of Technology admission process consists of multiple rounds. Candidates must qualify for all the rounds of the selection process to get admission. Find below the detailed process for MSIT admissions 2025:
Step 1: MSIT Application Process 2025

The MSIT application process is conducted in online as well as offline modes. Candidates must apply through the counseling bodies' websites of respective courses using basic details such as personal and educational qualifications. Along with that, they must pay an application fee for the respective course.
Step 2: MSIT Selection Rounds

After filling out the application form, candidates must appear for the respective entrance exam for MSIT course admissions. The shortlisted candidates must appear for further counseling rounds for the respective courses. The institute might conduct a PI round for a few courses.
Step 3: MSIT Final Admission

After the completion of all the selection rounds, shortlisted candidates get admission to the respective courses as per the merit list. Students whose names appear on the merit list are required to visit the institute for reporting, upload documents, and pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.question: Is Meghnad Saha Institute of Technology good for placements?
faqs.answer: Yes, Meghnad Saha Institute of Technology has a good placement record with many regional, national, and international companies visiting the campus every year. In the placement season of 2023, more than 330 students were placed across 175 companies that visited the institute campus. Some of the top companies that visit the campus are McAfee, ThoughtWorks Technologies, HashedIn, Amazon, AGS Technologies, CTS, DTDC, Hitachi, IBM, ITC Infotech, LTI, Microsoft, Geotech, Godrej, Indigo Airlines, Informatica, Infosys, Capgemini, Wipro, Zycus, and many more. The highest salary offered at the Meghnath Saha Institute Of Technology placement drive was INR 32 lakhs per annum, and the average package offered was INR 4.65 lakhs.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is pretty good. But the campus is very small, having no grounds.
reviews.review_text: The college has a pretty big library offering numerous books. The Wi-Fi connection is also decent. However, the college has no hostel of its own. The labs here also have various equipment and are air conditioned. The college also has a canteen and offers good food.

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty members and placement assistants.
reviews.review_text: The CSE department has well-equipped computer labs a table WiFi and projectors in classrooms. The library is resourceful with both physical and digital access. Hostel facility is not available. The mess food is average but hygienic. Overall the infrastructure is sufficient for academic needs.

reviews.review_heading: Placement and faculty are well.
reviews.review_text: CSE department has well-equipped labs, updated systems, high-speed Wi-Fi, SMART classrooms, and access to digital libraries. Campus is Wi-Fi enabled with decent cleanliness and maintenance. No hostel facilities at college, food in canteen is average but hygienic. Canteen serves good food at reasonable prices.

reviews.review_heading: Consistent placement and qualified teachers.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college provides an average campus with good classrooms, fully AC libraries, and decent practical labs. Wi-Fi connections are good at times but generally cut out due to the area where the college is situated. The hostels in my college a decent ones with good food, but with a smaller space for rooms. It is nearer to my college which is good for my transportation.

reviews.review_heading: A strong start in cyber security.
reviews.review_text: Meghnad Saha Institute of Technology College has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and access to a digital and central library. Hostel facilities are decent; food is average in the mess and canteen. Medical, sports and indoor games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Meaningful review of MSIT.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. The library is good, and all necessary books are available. Not all classrooms have ACs. Wi-Fi is not available everywhere. There is a little bit of a network issue in some places in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college for students.
reviews.review_text: There are plenty of good classes for every department, with labs equipped with AC and computers for every student. Wi-Fi network is great. The library is fully air-conditioned and has plenty of books, along with an online library and reading area. However, no hostel is available here.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is good. You will get a chance during placement season.
reviews.review_text: It is good. But the hostel facility is not available in our college. My college has provided a good environment for learning and growth.

reviews.review_heading: Not so satisfied with the college campus. Good placements in 2022 and good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in every room. The lab's facilities are good enough. No AC in the classroom. They are indeed neat and clean. We do have our college canteen which serves delicious food at a reasonable price. We don't have any playground but annually. We have our cricket and football tournament.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, decent college and good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Decent speed Wi-Fi is available on campus and every student has access to the central library and you can get books of your respective courses there. Classrooms are mainly clean. College doesn't have its own hostel. I'm currently at a hostel outside the college campus. College doesn't have a play ground also.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely nice college and with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are very nicely maintained and have every facility. In summer, there is no centralized air conditioning so it gets hard during summers otherwise, it's very good. The Wi-Fi speed is also fast.

reviews.review_heading: A good college in terms of study, college life, fest, technologies etc.
reviews.review_text: Our department is good about study, learning new technologies, creative innovation etc. Almost every thing required for a good learning environment is present here. We have Wi-Fi in campus, classrooms are good, in library there are plenty of books. We don't have hostel in our college but there are plenty of private hostel, mess, pgs are available here with good foods, good environment, medical facilities etc.

reviews.review_heading: A decent reputed private engineering college for pursuing B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: This college has efficient laboratories and library space and has its own canteen also. I am in the information technology branch and for us, the labs and equipments are good enough. We have Wi-Fi in every class with a PC and projector for side presentations. This college does not have any hostel, students have to rely on third-party hostels and PGs. Anyhow we also have a common room for indoor games on the small campus.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, decent placements in 2024, and good lab facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-organized. Labs are well-equipped with proper desktop setup and have Intel core i7 processors and Linux OS. It works very well. The library contains a wide range of books. It's just that students need to be interested and keen to learn new things only, then they can utilize these facilities to the fullest. Hostels are not included on the campus but one can find hostels and PGs outside the college area. There is no playground available. The campus is really small.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, facilities, placement cell and the mentors are really good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is overall good. All the classrooms have projectors. There is AC in all the lab classes and also in the library. Wi-Fi is available in the classroom. There are 2 playing rooms in the college where every student can come and rest and enjoy themselves.

SRMGPC admission process includes registration, selection and fee payment. Below are the steps to get a seat in SRMGPC:
STEP 1: SRMGPC Application Process 2025

Candidates must download the application form from the official website of SRMGPC. Besides, candidates can also apply online. Aspirants need to pay an application fee to apply for a course. Candidates will also need to submit the specified documents during the application process.
STEP 2: Selection

The selection method by SRMGPC includes shortlisting candidates depending on their performance in respective entrance exams, i.e. either UPSEE or LUMAT.Each application is evaluated using the criteria of eligibility for the chosen course.The score in the entrance exam and the background in academics are used to determine merit.Any applicants who are not eligible are disqualified.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation

Shortlisted candidates get to know that they have been recruited.Admission confirmation requires candidates to pay course fee within the stipulated deadline.At this stage, it may be necessary to submit original documents so as to verify them.The process of admission ends only after the fee payment and verification have been accepted successfully.

placement_data.title: SR University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The placements 2025 concluded with 92% of campus placements. The highest and average package offered during SR University placements 2025 was INR 51 LPA and INR 6.5 LPA , respectively. The top 10 percentile average package stood at INR 21 LPA . More than 150 recruiters participated in the placements 2025. The total number of job offers was more than 1,200. The highest stipend offered during internships 2025 was INR 1.25 lakh per month .

faqs.question: What is the highest package offered at SR University?
faqs.answer: The highest package offered during SR University placements 2025 was INR 51 LPA. This was offered to CSE branch students. Alongside, the average package offered during placements 2025 was INR 6.5 LPA.

faqs.question: What is the placement scenario at SR University?
faqs.answer: The placement data for 2025 is out. The campus placement percentage stood at 92%. The highest package offered was INR 51 LPA. The overall average package offered was INR 6.5 LPA. The average package for top 10 percentile stood at INR 21 LPA. More than 150 recruiters participated in the SR University placements 2025.

faqs.question: Does SR University conduct seminars to upskill students in BBA course?
faqs.answer: Yes, SR University regularly conducts business hackathons and startup shows. It provides a significant exposure to the students. In addition to theoretical and academic skills, students get wide exposure, and gain practical skills essential for final placements. The university provides certifications from reputed organizations as well.

faqs.question: Does SR University provides internships to students in BBA course?
faqs.answer: Yes, the BBA course curriculum at SR University consists of internships. It helps students gain practical knowledge and industry experience. Students complete core-specific internships and projects. The university organizes workshops and guest lectures to provide wider industry knowledge to students. Thus, students get placed in some top companies like HCL, Wipro, RBL Bank, and more.

paragraphs: Rajarambapu Institute of Technology is open for all its courses. Admission to the courses is both merit-based and entrance-based.Rajarambapu Institute of Technologyoffers various courses atundergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and doctoral levels in engineering, management, and technology.All programs are affiliated with Shivaji University and approved by AICTE.Admissions are primarily conducted through the Centralised Admission Process (CAP) managed by the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Maharashtra.However, candidates can also on the college's official website,depending on the course. Read the article below to know more about Rajarambapu Institute of Technology admission, course-eligiblity and selection criteria:

Rajarambapu Institute of Technology courses admission is open. The institute offers BTech, MTech, MBA, diploma and PhD courses. Admission to its course is both merit-based and entrance-based. Check outRajarambapu Institute of Technology courseeligibility & selection criteria in the following table:

RIT admission is entrance-based for all courses. Applicants are required to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process to get admission. Find below the detailed Rajarambapu Institute of Technology admission process for 2025:
Step 1: RIT Application Process

Candidates must register on the DTE Maharashtra portal and participate in the CAP rounds to apply for admission to UG, PG and diploma courses. Further, forPhDandremaining seats after CAP Counselling, candidates can directly apply by downloading the application form from the official website of RIT.

After completing the online application, candidates must appear for the relevant entrance exams for their chosen courses. The exams are as follows:
B.Tech (First Year):MHT-CET or JEE Main
Direct Second Year B.Tech:Diploma CET
M.Tech:GATE
MBA:MAH MBA/MMS CET
Diploma:Based on SSC marks (for CAP Counselling)
Ph.D.:Entrance test and interview conducted by Shivaji University
After the entrance exam, candidates will be shortlisted and must attend theCAP Counsellingprocess for seat allocation. The counselling will be based on merit.

After the completion of all selection rounds and CAP Counselling, the college releases the final merit list. Candidates who are shortlisted will be called for reporting at the institute for document verification. After document verification, candidates are required to pay theRajarambapu Institute of Technology fee to grab the seat.

placement_data.title: RIT Placement overview 2024
paragraphs: RIT Kolhapur has published its placement statistics for 2024, indicating that BTech students received a total of 441 job offers. The highest and average salary packages for BTech graduates were INR 9.13 LPA and INR 4 LPA, respectively. The Mechatronics and Civil Engineering programs achieved a remarkable 100% placement rate during RIT Kolhapur placements. The placement rates for Computer Science & IT and Computer Science Engineering were 96.49% and 94.41% , while Electronics and Telecommunication recorded a 93.33% placement rate. The automobile branch had the lowest placement rate at 64.29%. All 9 MTech students secured placements during RIT Kolhapur placements 2024.

In the BBA program, 4 companies hired 26 students , offering a top package of INR 2.4 LPA and an average of INR 1.48 LPA . For MBA placements, 108 students were placed with the highest package reaching INR 5.10 LPA , and the average package for the 2024 season was INR 3.33 LPA. Additionally, during Diploma placements, 26 students were placed during RIT Kolhapur placements with an average package of INR 2.74 LPA.

individual_reviews.title: My experience as a CSE Student at JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus, Greater Noida.

content.Placements: I am a B.Tech CSE student at JIMS EMTC, Greater Noida, graduating in 2027, and the placement performance of the 2024 batch has been very motivating. Last year, around 90-93% of CSE students were placed, with packages ranging from 3-3.5 LPA to the highest of 28 LPA, and an average of 6.5-7 LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Cognizant, Capgemini, IBM, HCL, Amazon, and several product-based startups. About 80-85% students also secured internships in leading tech firms. The strong training, workshops, and mock interviews provided by the college clearly contribute to these impressive results.

1. Application Process
2. Screening and Shortlisting

The JIMS Greater Noida admissions are entrance based. For BTech admissions, candidates are judged either on the basis of the JEE Mains or the IPU CET entrance exam course. The IPU CET entrance exam scores are used to decide the admissions for the rest of the courses.
3. Confirmation of Admissions

After the screening stage, selected candidates are called for the counseling rounds where they are alloted seats. Once the candidates have been alloted seats in their chosen course, they will need to pay the JIMS Greater Noida admission fees to confirm their admission. Generally, the admission fee for JIMS Greater Noida is a small portion of the totalcourse fee.

courses_data.description: The BBA course at JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus is a 3 year undergraduate program. Students can get a strong foundation of business management, marketing, finance. It aims to provide leadership and decision making skills to students.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for BBA at JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus?
faqs.answer: Entry into JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus's BBA course is entry-level through the IPU CET exam. Candidates with the preferred cutoff are shortlisted for the counselling session, where seat allotment is done on rank and vacancy basis. After selection, students need to undergo document verification and admission fee payment to confirm their seat.

faqs.question: What are the career opportunities after completing BBA from JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus?
faqs.answer: JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus BBA students are given career options in marketing, finance, human resource, banking, and business development. Certain students pursue further studies such as an MBA or professional courses like CA, CS, or CFA. Some of the renowned corporate companies, startup companies, financial institutions, and multinational firms are among the prominent recruiters of the institute providing managerial and business job positions.

faqs.question: Where can a candidate find JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus cut off?
faqs.answer: Candidates can find the JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus cutoff on the official website of Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU), which releases the cutoff for the campus's various programs like B.Tech and BCA based on their respective entrance exams (JEE Main and IPU CET).

faqs.question: Can I join JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus directly?
faqs.answer: Entrance tests like IPU CET or JEE Main are generally required to be cleared by most UG and PG courses of JIMS Greater Noida. But in a few instances, direct admission based on management quota or merit list is possible. The candidates are requested to inquire from the admission office if there is any course that does not require an entrance test. Academic performance and eligibility criteria are of primary importance for some programs.

faqs.question: Are admissions at JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus (JEMTEC) admissions are entrance-based and merit-based, course-wise. For BTech, the applicants need to qualify in JEE Main or IPU CET, whereas BBA, BCA, and BCom admissions are through IPU CET. The process of selection is based on satisfying eligibility criteria, entrance test marks, and counselling. Merit-based admissions can be there in certain cases, but entrance examination qualification is needed for most courses.

faqs.question: Can I take admission to JIMS Engineering Management Technical Campus with 50% in Class 12?
faqs.answer: Yes, for BBA, BCA, and BCom, candidates must have at least 50% aggregate in Class 12 to apply. But for BTech, 55% PCM is mandatory. Admission to all these courses depends on entrance tests such as IPU CET or JEE Main. Getting the eligibility and passing the entrance test is a must to get admission.

faqs.question: What can students do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Supportive faculty, great infrastructure, good placements, and an active, vibrant campus life.

content.Placements: In our batch of B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (2025) under Gujarat Technological University, around 70–75 percent of students are successfully placed. The highest package offered is around 8 LPA, the average package is about 3.5 LPA, and the lowest is around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, L&T, Bosch, and eInfochips. Nearly 60 percent of students received internships in reputed firms like BSNL, Reliance Jio, and Tata Communications. The major roles offered are embedded engineer, network engineer, design engineer, and software developer.

reviews.review_heading: College review of the Government Engineering College of Gandhinagar.
reviews.review_text: Our college is fully Wi-Fi enabled and classrooms have multiple air-conditioners. The Government Engineering College of Gandhinagar has a good hostel outside our college. The sports are also good.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely nice because of seniors, faculty members, and different communities.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure includes a huge, clean music community, gymkhana, and library. They have different clubs, like the Cell. The hostel facilities are comfortable and cheap. In our time, the canteen facilities were not available, but they have a good sports community.

reviews.review_heading: Solid foundation, self-driven growth at GEC, Gandhinagar.
reviews.review_text: Labs are fully functional for M&I, control systems, PLC/SCADA, and DCS. Wi-Fi is available but not reliable, with modest speed. The library has technical books for all fields. Hostels are available for both girls and boys, but there is no mess in the hostels. There is a canteen on the college premises with only limited options.

reviews.review_heading: GEC Gandhi Nagar- A deemed college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good here. There are libraries, a canteen, Wi-Fi, classrooms, and labs. Every subject has its own laboratory. All labs have the required equipment. The hostel has a mess and canteen. Sports grounds are there to have fun with friends.

reviews.review_heading: My college is a government college, and one must have high merit to enroll here.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and all the amenities such as Wi-Fi, labs, and the library are available on the college campus. The library department is separate from the college department; it is common for all branches. The labs for all subjects are available. As I am not living in the college hostel, I do not know much about it, but as per my friends, it is average, as the meals are not good and the canteen is not available within the campus. There is no ground in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Mixed faculty quality; some are excellent, while others are poor. Average placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in limited areas. Computer labs are there but not in good condition. Classrooms are good and also have projectors. I do not have experience with the hostel, but it can be said to be average. Water is not available in the toilets, and the drinking water is not good.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and faculty are poor.
reviews.review_text: In our college, Government Engineering College Gandhinagar, facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are not the best, but they are average. The Wi-Fi sometimes does not work properly. The hostel is also average, and sometimes we face difficulties like water issues.

reviews.review_heading: A good place to learn with love and bonding with each other.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available on the campus, but they are not well maintained by the users. Especially, toilets are not cleaned well and water management is weak. There is quite a good meal available, but it is not healthy. A number of snacks are available in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Mysterious Journey to My College Life.
reviews.review_text: There are in total 8 buildings or blocks in our college, which include one library, one canteen, and one administrative office. The college has Wi-Fi facilities, but the speed is a little slow, though useful if needed. There are labs, but some of the computers are not working well, and some classrooms have broken windows and tables.

reviews.review_heading: Good Review of GEC, Gandhinagar.
reviews.review_text: The Electronics and Communication Engineering course faculties are good, and the facilities include Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, canteen, etc. Many PG rooms are available in the city. The hostel is good, but no mess is available. The canteen food quality is good, and the medical facility provides an annual check-up of the body.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of good facilities and a good environment, 2024.
reviews.review_text: Our department has Wi-Fi, RO water supply, projectors, computers, medical facilities, etc. The environment is good. For sports, we have basketball, volleyball, and football grounds. The canteen food is tasty, the water is cool, and cleaning is good. Wi-Fi is fast, and there are many plants in my college.

reviews.review_heading: My mysterious and lovely college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Government Engineering College Gandhinagar is very good at everything as it contains a total of 8 buildings in it. Five buildings are of departments, 1 for the library, 1 for the canteen, and 1 for administrative information. So the overall infrastructure of the college is very good, and the campus looks nice. The hostel does not have a good ground for play.

data.description: Students are sure to appreciate the vast pool of structural amenities made available by the administration of Government Engineering College, Gandhinagar. The campus is surrounded by lush greenery and is conducive to inclusive learning. Students get access to Chanakya Hall, C.V. Raman Hall, Yoga Center , among other facilities. Also provided is the well-stocked central library with 13,770 books and 4,400 titles.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Muzaffarpur Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The college is too old. This college was built in 1954. The main building has the main office, mechanical, and civil departments. It has a library. The other buildings have ECE, EE, and IT buildings. They provide a separate pharmacy, lab buildings, 2 labs with computer service, and one cafeteria. Our college has 6 hostels for boys. Our college has 1 hostel for girls. Some buildings are under construction. A huge workshop is available in our college. It has many old machines.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Muzaffarpur Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with all facilities. Our college has good sports culture. Wi-Fi facility is available in our department. It is not available in the hostel. The hostel is good and hygienic. There is a cafeteria in the middle of the campus. A playground is available for cricket and football. Our college has 2 badminton courts.

reviews.review_heading: The campus and faculty members are good, but hostel facilities are poor.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is below average. The hostel is very old with broken doors, windows and glasses. Four students live in each room. The food provided in the mess is just okay. The hostel is very uncomtable in the summer with frequent power cuts and defective fans.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty members and lab facilities, computer labs, and a well-maintained library.
reviews.review_text:
All buildings are well maintained, and we have enough labs with Wi-Fi and AC systems.
A well-maintained library and classrooms are there.
Hostel buildings are old, but the quality of food in the mess is really good.
Hostel buildings really need renovations, and the campus needs cleaning.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with my college, placement, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: This college was built in 1954; therefore, its infrastructure is old-fashioned, but it looks quite good. The hostel needs some maintenance, but the food quality is not as good as they charge for it. There is no medical facility here. But for sports facilities, it is good, and here one fest named UMANG happens every year for sports, where almost 40 colleges participate every year.

reviews.review_heading: It's worth it to take admission to this college.
reviews.review_text:
The labs and classrooms are good, but the library is just okay. There are lots of books available there, which you can access with permission. The labs are well maintained.
The hostel looks awesome. I really loved it.
There are just some maintenance issues there. All sports facilities are available in the hostel (outdoor and indoor games); medical facilities are also available.

These circuit boards run electrical signals to and from electrical components to accomplish everything from a mundane computer startup to controlling absolute power and precision of a rocket going out of earth's atmosphere.Know more about -Electrical Engineering Courses

individual_reviews.title: I am very satisfied with my college. Its teachers are very good and supportive.

content.Placements: Mostly, students are placed in my course. The average package is 6 LPA, with a max of 24 LPA and a min of 4 LPA. Overall, the placement environment is good. individual_reviews.title: Good placements in the upcoming years.

content.Placements: In civil engineering, minimum placement percentage is 30 to 40%. The highest package is around 8-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are L&T, Oil, etc. Internship percentage is 40-50%. Average package offered for a civil engineer is 5-6 LPA. The lowest package is around 3 LPA.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Our 1st engineering college in the entire North East India.

content.Placements: 70 to 80% of students get placed in our department. The highest package is 12LPA, and average is 6 to 7 LPA. Power Grind, ONGC, BPCL, Oil India Limited. individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The oldest engineering college of the Northeast has a great legacy.

content.Placements: Many reputed companies like OIL, NRL, Vedanta, L&T, Ashok Leyland, and many more visit the campus for placement drives and select students with good academics and the required skills. reviews.review_heading: The college offers excellent placements, a strong faculty, and a good range of choices.
reviews.review_text: AEC has well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, workshops, and separate hostels for boys and girls. We can use Wi-Fi when on the campus and in the hostel, which is 24/7. reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the placements and campus scenery.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is fast but not available 24/7. The labs are in good condition. The first-year classrooms are okay, but the department classrooms are absolutely amazing. The library is well-designed and good for self-study. The hostels are also in good condition, and the food provided by the hostel mess is okay, but the fest is awesome. The college canteen is fine and has low-cost food items that are affordable to buy and eat.

reviews.review_heading: A very good college for students with good placements, good teachers, and good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Inside Assam Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The labs at the college are above average, meeting basic requirements but lacking advanced equipment. Some areas have free Wi-Fi, which is helpful for students. The library is quite good, with a wide variety of books available. Hostel rooms are comfortable, mostly double-sharing, and the bathrooms and toilets are clean. The mess offers both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, including chicken and fish, though the taste could be improved. The canteen serves good food and has a large dining area....

reviews.review_heading: All about Assam Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructures of our courses are fine but a little out date and the same goes for the hostels as they are quite old now. The food is okay in comparison though. The Wi-fi might not be sufficient or strong enough in the hostels but it is in the main college campus and classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely good because of the location, faculty, technology, labs, hostel, and placements.
reviews.review_text: Accommodation of the hostel is very good in Assam Engineering College for both boys and girls. But the availability of seats is more than the seats for girls. The food is good in hostels of Assam Engineering College. The availability of a field for playing is good.

reviews.review_heading: College is very sophisticated and eco-friendly. One must residing in Assam should chose it for sure.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is well maintained, and rooms are also very well-maintained. Both have Wi-Fi connections with an eco-friendly nature. AC is provided in every room. Our library is the biggest library in Assam, and famous people visit it once a year to see the environment.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college that provides lots of opportunities for students who work hard.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good and very affordable. It only costs Rs. 2,400 per month, but a mess of H9 is not good in other hostels. The mess food is relatively good. The hostel has an open area, so we will not feel congested anyhow,  except for the new hostels like H9 and H8 in new blocks.

reviews.review_heading: College life at Assam Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure needs much more improvement. There is no indoor stadium. There is a college gym but it is not functional. Hostels at AEC are pretty good. There are 9 hostels, and 8 of them are for boys and 1 is for girls. Mess food varies for different hostels, but almost the food quality is okay.

reviews.review_heading: AEC campus is green and it is surrounded by beautiful hills.
reviews.review_text: Labs are above average and not very advanced with basic requirements. Certain places have free Wi-Fi. The library is quite good. Different types of books are available here. Hostel rooms are good and double-sharing. Bathrooms and toilets are also clean. The mess food is not so tasty but it offers both veg and non-veg food. In non-veg, they offer chicken and fish. The canteen also provides good food and a huge dining room. Almost all sports are held in college week.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: DSU is a great university with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in my course is 79 percent. The highest package is 17 LPA, the lowest is 3.3 LPA, and the average package offered is 7.3 LPA. The top recruiting company for my course is HCL. The percentage of students who got internships from my course is 60 percent.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department are average. Wi-Fi is available in the college. The labs and classrooms are good. All books are available in the library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is good. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: DSU is filled full of joy with some minor issues in hostel.

content.Placements: I think the last batch all got placed from this university. The highest package is 16 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Top role is not offered just to an employee or normal category. Students also get internships in Hyderabad. It is all about placements.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available but network is slow. In hostel, they try to put good food but plenty of people are there which is why some issues are there with food. Medical is always available at this university because hospital is there on campus. But doctor is not available at the correct time.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Excellent campus infrastructure. Good placement support. Salary packages range from 3 LPA to 13 LPA.

content.Placements: 100 percent of students got placement in my course. Their salary may be high or low, but everyone got placed in a company. Mostly small and start-up level companies are coming for campus hiring. The HRDC department is supportive in getting jobs and internships. Here are a few company names who came for hiring (Coding Mart, Kaar Technology, Space Zee, Avasoft, Tech Vaseegrah, Esales, Ladera Technology, Izeon, Technofort, Orion Shift, Code Young, Infomart, and more).
content.Infrastructure: The hostel life is very good. The infrastructure looks classic. Wi-Fi facility is available, but we don’t get proper network coverage. Even our phone network coverage is slower inside the campus. The classrooms in the academic block are classic. The SET block infrastructure is also good but not like the academic block. The libraries are available in the academic block, which have all types of books where you can learn a lot. The computer labs look very grand and they have a lot of computers. But the computers are not installed with all required softwares.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good campus, decent faculty, supportive environment, and opportunities for growth.

content.Placements: 88 per cent of the students were placed in this course, and many of them were placed in the best companies. Zoho, Infosys, TCL and some of the companies hire us from this college. 90 per cent of the students got an internship from this course, from companies like Tata, TCL and Infosys. I mentioned some companies.
content.Infrastructure: Our CS department is the highest-studying course in this university. We have many sections, a great infrastructure and many good faculty members. Many classes have AC and the best quality benches. They have a big auditorium and labs. Southern and northern types of food are available.

reviews.review_heading: DSU is a great university with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department are average. Wi-Fi is available in the college. The labs and classrooms are good. All books are available in the library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is good. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: DSU is filled full of joy with some minor issues in hostel.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available but network is slow. In hostel, they try to put good food but plenty of people are there which is why some issues are there with food. Medical is always available at this university because hospital is there on campus. But doctor is not available at the correct time.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus infrastructure. Good placement support. Salary packages range from 3 LPA to 13 LPA.
reviews.review_text: The hostel life is very good. The infrastructure looks classic. Wi-Fi facility is available, but we don’t get proper network coverage. Even our phone network coverage is slower inside the campus. The classrooms in the academic block are classic. The SET block infrastructure is also good but not like the academic block. The libraries are available in the academic block, which have all types of books where you can learn a lot. The computer labs look very grand and they have a lot of computers. But...

reviews.review_heading: Good campus, decent faculty, supportive environment, and opportunities for growth.
reviews.review_text: Our CS department is the highest-studying course in this university. We have many sections, a great infrastructure and many good faculty members. Many classes have AC and the best quality benches. They have a big auditorium and labs. Southern and northern types of food are available.

reviews.review_heading: This university is newly built.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available but network is slow. In hostel, they try to put good food but plenty of people are there which is why some issues are there with food. Medical is always available at this university because hospital is there on campus. But doctor is not available at the correct time.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied, really good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Labs and library are super. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is also good. Medical facilities, sports, and games are super and good enough.

reviews.review_heading: I refer this college to a student who is looking for a good environment to become a graduate.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have a friendly atmosphere. We have computer labs, and one lab is integrated with IBM. Few classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and a few others are under working. We have a library with full air-conditioning, and every book is available in the library. It has a huge library, so we can refer to any book there. The hostel is also good. The canteen is also available. There is a 24x7 free medical allowance.

reviews.review_heading: You can join this college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department are average. Wi-Fi is available in the college. The labs and classrooms are good. All books are available in the library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is good. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty and good placements in 2025.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the Computer Science department is modern. Our labs are equipped with decent configurations, internet access, and a variety of software. The hostel infrastructure has clean rooms. The food quality in the mess is good, and hygiene standards are maintained.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good university.
reviews.review_text: My classroom has fast Wi-Fi and NEET halls with air conditioning. The hostel rooms have attached bathrooms, and there are also common bathrooms. Every night, a doctor visits the hostel for consultations. The mess serves food with medicine provisions. There are 100 fans. Sports facilities are available, and students can study comfortably in the college.

reviews.review_heading: It is very good to take part in this university.
reviews.review_text: My classroom has fast Wi-Fi and neat halls with AC. The hostel rooms have attached bathrooms, and there are also common bathrooms available. Every night, our hostel has a doctor meeting with medicine. The mess has 100 fans. Sports activities are available without fees, and students can study in the same college.

reviews.review_heading: Good to study in this university and stay.
reviews.review_text: My classroom has fast Wi-Fi facility and neat halls with AC. The hostel has rooms with attached bathrooms and also common bathrooms. Every night, a doctor visits the hostel and provides medicine. The mess has 100 fans. Sports are taught without any extra fee, and students study in the same college.

reviews.review_heading: Dhanalakshmi is the trusted in the education.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure provided in this college, will be too good and also the course department is too good. There is no Wi-Fi problem, on the ID of the roll number per person the daily 2.5 GB will be there for the purpose. Also, the mess with food quality is too food and lots of food items in this college. It has sports with a large ground.

reviews.review_heading: The college life at this college is good.
reviews.review_text: My classroom has fast Wi-Fi and neat halls with AC. Hostel has rooms with attached bathrooms and also has common bathrooms. Every night our hostel has a doctor meeting with medicine. Mess has 100 fans. Sports are studied without fee and students study in the same college.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, with good faculty.
reviews.review_text: My classroom has fast Wi-Fi and air-conditioned halls. The hostel rooms come with attached bathrooms, as well as common bathrooms. Every night, our hostel holds doctor meetings for medical needs. Sports are studied without distractions, allowing us to focus on our studies in the same college.
